view.scene_description: A warehouse aisle with tall metal racks filled with red plastic crates. A forklift is parked on the right side of the aisle. Yellow safety posts line the aisle. The floor is concrete, and overhead lights illuminate the space. The perspective suggests movement along the aisle.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Stacked in multiple rows on metal racks, occupying left and center portions of the frame. Crates have ventilation holes and white labels. Some are partially obscured by racks or other crates. They rest on pallets or rack bases. Visible from foreground to mid-ground.

objects.label: metal shelving racks
objects.observation: Tall, gray metal structures holding red crates. Extend vertically and horizontally along both sides of the aisle. Have yellow safety rails at top. Visible from foreground to background, supporting crates and defining aisle boundaries.

objects.label: yellow safety post
objects.observation: Cylindrical, bright yellow post near the bottom-left corner. Partially obscures view of adjacent crates. Appears freestanding on the floor. Positioned between the viewer and the racks.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Black and orange forklift on the right side of the aisle. Has a logo on its side. Forks are lowered. Wheels are on the concrete floor. Partially obstructs view of shelves behind it. Appears stationary.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: Smooth, light-gray surface extending throughout the aisle. Reflects overhead lighting. Provides base for racks, forklift, and safety posts. Shows some wear and minor debris.

objects.label: overhead lighting fixtures
objects.observation: White fluorescent lights suspended from ceiling. Emit bright illumination. Located above the aisle, casting even light across the scene. Visible in upper portion of image.
